name.description:
If no fields are populated on the Genai.LlmGuardrails.Processor, it will not be correctly persisted on
{@link Genai.LlmGuardrails.Manager#inputProcessors} or {@link Genai.LlmGuardrails.Manager#outputProcessors},
so this field exists to ensure that all processors are correctly persisted.

promptParamsToScan.description: The values of {@link Genai.Prompt#params} to scan.

piiClasses.description:
Collection of string constants representing various types of sensitive
information or identifiable data. PiiMasking can be removed from
the output processor depending on the user requirements.
See {@link https://microsoft.github.io/presidio/supported_entities/#list-of-supported-entities}

title:
An output processor guardrail for performing PII masking, i.e., to the process of obscuring or hiding sensitive personal
information in a dataset from unauthorized users.
name: Genai.LlmGuardrails.Processor.PiiMasking
